items.text: It chose a peasant boy... over seven rulers.
We were done kneeling to Queen Alia. Tonight... we stood up.
Then the guards moved. Everything went wrong... fast.
I searched for my parents. Found them... in chains.
I tried to free them. I failed.
I ran. They hunted. Then... the sky answered.
A fallen star. Like nothing ever made on Nopaltia.
It was calling me... like it already knew my name.
Far away... the prodigy Queen felt it.
She's coming for it. And for me.
